1479-3478-8337.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

997-7084-8338.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

6441-7282-8160.easyPrerequisites:
Kwia's ability hasn't triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
6441-7282-8160.description:
Gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating two Lotus tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate a Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of the Lotus token.
Activate two Loti by tapping and sacrificing them, adding six mana of any color.
Repeat from step 4.
6441-7282-8160.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Chrome Dome can target other artifacts as desired.

2104-2707-7654.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, causing you to put Temporal Manipulation on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

3995-6723-7008.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3995-6723-7008.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1286-3899-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-3899-5972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2749-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
2749-6034-8089.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

997-1981-2415-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-5789.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2397-2908-3821.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2397-2908-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4289-4359-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-4359-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-4359-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2645-3918-7685.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

413-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
413-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
When the Squirrels enter, Blasting Station triggers that many times.
Resolve a Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 at least three additional times. Afterwards, resolve any remaining Blasting Station triggers.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5256-5434.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-5686-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

940-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
940-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to it.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-6913.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Chameleon.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Chameleon by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

826-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3781-3967-4215--124.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3781-3967-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

474-4192-4394-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {R}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

3152-4518-6623.description:
Activate Somberwald Sage by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Somberwald Sage.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6114.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4659-6114.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Skyknight Squire triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1365-4853-5147--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-5147--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1240-4321-4659-4679.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
1240-4321-4659-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control and a Food artifact token, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing the Aura token, regenerating Gatherer of Graces.
Repeat.

2281-2732-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Saffi dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Saffi from your graveyard.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher, adding one mana of any color.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Saffi from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1953-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra and Brudiclad trigger.
Resolve the Mishra trigger, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get four energy counters.
Resolve the Brudiclad trigger, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Myr enters the battlefield, Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get four energy counters.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight energy counters and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-2160-2239-2697.manaNeeded: {R}{R} on your first turn, with {1}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
618-2160-2239-2697.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Last Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Last Chance triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

855-2060-2854-4770.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
855-2060-2854-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
